decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during parc fermé.
offence: Breaches of Articles B8.2.2 (read with B8.2.3) and B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The use of the 4th Energy Store and Control Electronics Unit would have resulted in a grid drop penalty, however as the Technical Delegates approval was not obtained, this means, in accordance with Article B3.5.3 of the FIA F1 Regulations a start from the pit lane.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 Pu Elements Changed Under Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
